title: vgio/cameras/v6.0
description: A vgio/cameras/v6.0 file, as VisualGeometryToolkitIO writes and reads it; generated from its validator (VisualGeometryToolkitIO.json_schema). The validator is the authority: a check stated only in a `description` is the reader's. A file of a higher minor version of this major may hold keys this version does not declare: validate it against its own version's schema. camera names are unique (the identity configs refer to)

schema.description: vgio/cameras/v6.0, or the same major version at any minor

length.description: a registered length unit (mm, cm, m, um, inch)

pixel.description: a registered pixel frame (colmap, opencv, julia)

length_roles.description: length role → its length unit, for the fields whose lengths are not in `length`

additionalProperties.description: a registered length unit (mm, cm, m, um, inch)

lens.description: VisualGeometryToolkitCore's lens record (`lens_record`): every key a lens leaf's tag or a combinator (`add`, `lift`, `spline`), every value its coefficient array of the leaf's arity, as `lens_from_record` reads it

pitch.description: a pixel pitch is two positive lengths per pixel, in units.length

prefixItems.title: theta
prefixItems.description: the major axis's angle from +x, rad

calibration_record.description: a calibration block states at least one key

then.description: `lens_coverage` is exactly one of `circle` (r > 0), `ellipse` (a ≥ b > 0) or `rect` (width, height > 0)

type.description: "noncentral_spline" — a central grid camera is a camera with a spline lens (its `lens` the spline record)

present.description: the present nodes as runs per row, [[row, [[col_lo, col_hi], …]], …], 1-based: each row once, rows increasing; a row's runs nonempty, col_lo ≤ col_hi, increasing and apart (a gap of at least one node)

spline.description: the area's width and height are > 0; the lattice has at least 4 × 4 nodes; `present` names rows ≤ grid_size.height and columns ≤ grid_size.width; every control array has one entry per held node (grid_size.width × grid_size.height without `present`)
